hero.title: Who is Eder Balbino
hero.subtitle: Courage to face the new. I'm third.

origins_purpose.title: Origins and Purpose
origins_purpose.intro_short: Discover my humble beginnings and the journey that shaped my purpose.
origins_purpose.paragraph1: I was born in a simple home in Belo Horizonte (MG), the fifth child of Pedro Balbino and Maria José — a couple who taught me the value of faith, integrity, and generosity. My father was a pastor and founder of a Baptist church, and I grew up surrounded by music, friendship, and spirituality. I was a drummer in my youth and had a passion for rock'n roll.
origins_purpose.paragraph1_summary: Born in Belo Horizonte, I learned faith, integrity, and generosity from my parents.
origins_purpose.paragraph2: Since I was 7 years old, I dreamed of entrepreneurship. I saved coins to one day have my own company — although I spent it all on popsicles from Dona Teófila when friends came to visit. It was the first of many lessons about investment and generosity.
origins_purpose.paragraph2_summary: My childhood dream of entrepreneurship and early lessons in investment and generosity.

education_learning.title: Education and Learning
education_learning.paragraph1: I hold a degree in Statistics and a postgraduate degree in Strategic Information Management from UFMG, one of Brazil's three most renowned universities.
education_learning.paragraph2: I also have a degree in Theology from the Society of Interdisciplinary Biblical Studies (SEBI) in Brasília.
education_learning.paragraph3: My English was born from a personal challenge: I studied 12 hours a day for three months and completed the entire English Live (formerly English Town) course. The effort paid off: I ranked 1st worldwide, with double the points of the second-place finisher.

mission.title: Mission
mission.paragraph1: I am a man of reformed faith and a missions pastor at Igreja Missão VIDE (Integral Vision of the Gospel), where I lead teams that support 20 missionary families in countries such as Mozambique, Angola, Tunisia, Spain, France, and Brazil.

chaos.title: Chaos
chaos.paragraph1: I believe in God's sovereignty and transformation through suffering. In 2023, I faced one of the greatest trials of my life when I was targeted by a Federal Police operation authorized by Minister Alexandre de Moraes. I was investigated for a political plot involving then-president Jair Bolsonaro, after my system identified flaws in electronic voting machines.
chaos.paragraph2: After 10 months of investigation, the Federal Police concluded that I had told the truth and done everything correctly. The case gained national and international repercussion, and I was called 'The Genius of Uberlândia'. Subsequently, I was summoned as a witness for both the defense and prosecution in the process conducted by the Brazilian Attorney General's Office.
chaos.paragraph3: This experience solidified my conviction that God is sovereign even in the valleys.

close_family.title: Close Family (Wife and Children)
close_family.paragraph1: I am married to the wonderful Heloísa Cristina and father of four incredible children: Emily (13), Sofia (10), Ravi (7), and Nicole (3).
close_family.summary: Meet my wife Heloísa Cristina and our four amazing children: Emily, Sofia, Ravi, and Nicole.

extended_family.title: Extended Family (Parents and Siblings)
extended_family.paragraph1: I am the youngest among my siblings Quesia, Dan, Júnia, and Sara, with whom I maintain a relationship of love and friendship.
extended_family.summary: Learn about my parents, Pedro Balbino and Maria José, and my siblings: Quesia, Dan, Júnia, and Sara.

pastoral_mission.title: Pastoral Life and Mission
pastoral_mission.paragraph1: As a pastor, writer, and mentor, I seek to inspire people to fully trust in God.
pastoral_mission.paragraph2: I am the author of the book 'Desista do Controle' (Give Up Control), a work about surrender and total dependence on the Lord.
pastoral_mission.paragraph3: I am also an investor in social projects in Africa, especially in Mozambique, through Missão NASCE, which receives 20% of Gaio's profits to support families and children in vulnerable situations.

career_entrepreneurship.title: Career and Entrepreneurship
career_entrepreneurship.intro: I have been an entrepreneur for over 25 years, having founded companies such as:

companies.lince: Lince (sold to Grupo Algar in 2014, where I worked as an executive for two years)

career_entrepreneurship.beelong_role: At Beelong, an American technology company focused on direct sales teams, I am Chief Strategy Officer, alongside Vince (USA) and Calebe (Brazil).
career_entrepreneurship.gaio_role: At Gaio, I am founder and CEO.
career_entrepreneurship.gaio_description: Gaio is a data intelligence startup that develops Gaio DataOS, a complete data operating system — capable of collecting, storing, processing, and analyzing billions of pieces of information in seconds, with Machine Learning, AI, and Business Intelligence features.

recognitions_achievements.title: Recognitions and Achievements
recognitions_achievements.item1: 🏆 Winner of InovAtiva Brasil, the largest startup acceleration program of the Federal Government (1st place among over 3,000).
recognitions_achievements.item2: 🌍 Selected by SEBRAE-MG to represent Brazil at GITEX Dubai 2025, the largest technology event in the Middle East.
recognitions_achievements.item3: 💳 Winner of the VISA Acceleration Program, with a one-month immersion in Silicon Valley, visiting Google, Airbnb, Meta, X, and Square.
recognitions_achievements.item4: 🏅 GPTW (Great Place to Work) Seal with maximum score (100/100) in 2025, leading Gaio with empathy, courage, and excellence.

professional_experience.title: Professional Experience
professional_experience.intro: I worked as an employee and participated in advanced data intelligence projects in various public and private institutions:

institutions.secretarias_fazenda: Secretarias de Fazenda (MG, MA, ES, MT)

professional_experience.professor_role: I was also a postgraduate professor in Data Science at PUC Minas and a professor at Jocum (YWAM).

speaker_mentor.title: Speaker and Mentor
speaker_mentor.paragraph1: Speaker at international Gartner and Informa events, I share about faith, technology, and purpose.
speaker_mentor.paragraph2: I mentor entrepreneurs and young people at the beginning of their careers, helping them find direction and purpose in what they do.

leadership_values.title: Leadership and Values
leadership_values.paragraph2: I believe that loving is not always pleasing — it is helping people become better. I once fixed a colleague's bumper and, in the same spirit of justice, had to dismiss three nephews on the same day. I do everything with excellence, as if for God.

international_experience.title: International Experience
international_experience.intro: I have worked and learned in various countries and cities around the world:
international_experience.usa: USA: San Francisco (Silicon Valley), Miami, Orlando, New York, Boston, Austin, Houston, Dallas, San Antonio
international_experience.europe: Europe: Paris, Lyon, London, Milan, Geneva, Dortmund, Frankfurt
international_experience.latin_america: Latin America: Buenos Aires, Mexico City
international_experience.middle_east: Middle East: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah
international_experience.brazil: Brazil: I have visited almost all state capitals in the country

technical_skills.title: Technical Skills
technical_skills.skills: Gaio DataOS, SAS, RapidMiner, KNIME, IBM Analytics, Watson, Tableau, QlikView, Python, SQL, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, Teradata, MemSQL, Docker, Linux, Windows, macOS, CRM Tools, MS Office, PHP

relational_characteristics.title: Relational Characteristics
relational_characteristics.characteristics: Innovative, Generous, Self-control, Pleasure in teaching, Patience, Intensity, Love

personal_philosophy.title: Personal Philosophy
personal_philosophy.quote: “There is inner peace even amidst outer war.”
personal_philosophy.explanation: I live with serenity in chaos, conviction in uncertainty, and unwavering faith in God's purpose.
